articles.title: Ditching bonds for bitcoin: How crypto can tackle the AI-heavy portfolio dilemma
articles.snippet: Bitcoin Suisse says rising AI investment, government debt and weakening stock-bond diversification strengthen the case for adding bitcoin to traditional portfolios.
